errors.text_span: eine hellblaue Linie mit runden Markierungen repräsentiert den Mittelwert der Nachfrage
errors.evidence: The description identifies the line for the mean value ('Mittelwert') as 'hellblaue Linie' (light blue line). This creates ambiguity as there are three shades of blue. The mean line is the medium shade, while the minimum line is the lightest shade. This mapping can cause confusion between the mean and minimum series.
